browser_pkce.title: Log in to your Panasonic account
browser_pkce.description:
1. Open this link in any browser: {authorize_url}
2. Log in with your Panasonic ID (the same account the Eolia app uses).
3. The page will fail to load after you log in -- **this is expected**, ignore any error shown.
4. Open your browser's Developer Tools (F12 on Windows/Linux, Cmd+Option+I on Mac) and switch to the **Network** tab.
5. Find the request whose Name starts with `panasonic-eolia:` and click it.
6. Copy the full **Request URL** shown in the right-hand panel (it contains `code=...`).
7. Paste that whole URL below.

paste_refresh_token.title: Enter a refresh token
paste_refresh_token.description: Paste a refresh_token you already obtained (for example, by running this repo's PKCE helper script by hand once).

error.invalid_code: Couldn't find a code= value in what you pasted. Paste the full URL DevTools showed you, or just the code by itself.
error.code_exchange_failed: Panasonic rejected that code -- it may have expired (they're single-use and short-lived). Try the login link again.

abort.already_configured: This Panasonic account is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Eolia API to finish setup. Check your connection and try again.
abort.missing_account_id: Panasonic's login response didn't include the expected account information. Please try again.
